card.name: Inside lactate and acetate salt names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a salt name, such as lact or acet, right after a drug name (milrinone, caspofungin, erythromycin, haloperidol). It sits just before the ending -ate or -obionate.

modes.label: lact- after drug
modes.description: The lact piece of a lactate or lactobionate salt following a drug name.

modes.label: acet- after drug
modes.description: The acet piece of an acetate salt following a drug name.
modes.example: caspofungin<< acet>>ate for injection with other intravenous substances

card.writes: It pushes toward finishing chemical salt names such as oxide, carbonate and sodium, and away from Qt programming terms.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of drug salt names like lactate and acetate, just before the ending is completed.
